contract.quiet_true: Suppress the assistant reply before the UI/TTS split: no assistant text is published and no paired TTS is enqueued.
contract.quiet_false: If normal assistant text is admitted, the same reply path also admits its paired TTS; policy cannot intentionally produce text-only output.
contract.legacy_speech_muted: Compatibility field only; normalized to false and ignored by the core output gate.
contract.fast_commands: Exact commands such as 别说话 and 说吧 keep the synchronous current-turn override to close classifier/plugin latency.

implementation.core_boundary: N.E.K.O reply-output admission before text/TTS split
implementation.config_reuse: Existing NEKO_PRIVATE_SPEECH_GATE_FILE is reused; no second state/config path added.
implementation.tts_behavior: Independent TTS enqueue/send mute checks removed.

failure_prevented: The prior design allowed speech_muted=true while UI text remained enabled, creating a policy-induced 'text visible but no voice' state. v0.6 makes that state unrepresentable.
